agents.name: profile-architect
agents.description: Designs the narrowest correct shared, profile, and consumer-local authority boundary before profile changes are authored.

agents.name: token-accessibility-auditor
agents.description: Audits canonical and consumer token usage together with accessibility requirements and reports evidence-backed remediation.

agents.name: consumer-migration-specialist
agents.description: Plans and, only when explicitly authorized, applies a preview-first migration to the managed design-system delivery.

agents.name: design-system-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews a consumer implementation against canonical authority, its selected product profile, and integration health without editing it.

goldenScenarios.prompt: Decide whether the Gateway command palette rule belongs in the shared foundation or its product profile.
Audit these token mappings for WCAG contrast, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion problems.
Migrate this legacy design-system submodule to the managed payload, showing the dry-run before any apply.
Review this pull request for design drift against the selected product profile.
